fields.description: Visitors with a nationality other than this country are treated as foreign nationals. Leave blank to use the site's country (System Settings).
fields.label: Home Country

fields.description: Used as the expected check-out when a pass or invitation does not specify one.
fields.label: Default Checkout Time

fields.description: Enable physical badge issuance for visitors. If disabled, visitors will only get QR codes.
fields.label: Enable Badge

fields.description: Superseded by 'Requires Physical Badge' on each Visitor Type. Retained only for sites that have not yet set that flag.
fields.label: Badge Required For (legacy)

fields.description: Leave OFF (the default) to require every declared item to be verified before a Check-In or Check-Out can be saved. Tick only if your site deliberately admits visitors without checking their declared items.
fields.label: Allow Gate Events Without Item Verification
Blacklist Action
fields.options:
Block Entry
Alert Only
Log Only

fields.description: Shows New Walk-In on Gate Desk, the Visitor Pass list and the Security Log: a short form for a visitor who turns up without a pass. The pass still goes to the Visitor Type's approver. When off, every visitor needs a pass raised by a host.
fields.label: Let the Gate Register Walk-In Visitors

fields.description: When QR Scan Required at Gate is on, a walk-in registered minutes ago has no QR to show. With this on the guard picks the pass and writes why there was no scan; the reason stays on the Security Log. When off, walk-ins are scanned like everyone else.
fields.label: Let a Walk-In In Without a QR Scan

fields.description: The guard sees a warning when a visitor arrives or leaves outside the booked time (plus the tolerance), and the Security Log keeps a note and the Outside Booked Time flag. The check-in or check-out is always recorded.
fields.label: Warn When Outside the Booked Time

fields.description: How far outside the booked time a visitor may arrive or leave before the gate warns and notes it on the Security Log, and before the host is told a visitor is still inside. The gate never refuses entry or exit for the time of day.
fields.label: Gate Time Tolerance (minutes)

fields.description: How far ahead a visit may be scheduled. At least 1 day; there is no "no limit" setting — enter a large number of days instead.
fields.label: Max Advance Booking (days)

fields.description: ISD code applied to local mobile numbers, without '+'. Leave blank to use the home country's code.
fields.label: Default Phone Country Code

fields.description: Body temperature at or above which a Contact Trace Record's exposure risk is classified High. Health policy differs by site and authority.
fields.label: Fever Threshold (°C)

fields.description: Every 15 minutes, the host and Security get a bell alert and an email for a visitor still inside after the expected check-out plus the tolerance. Once per visitor per day.
fields.label: Alert When a Visitor Stays Past Check-Out

fields.description: The host and whoever raised the pass get a bell alert and an email when their visitor is marked as a no-show (No-Show Grace above).
fields.label: Tell the Host About a No-Show

fields.description: Sent once, after the visitor is checked out and the booked time of the last day is over. The wording is the VMS Visitor Thank You notification.
fields.label: Email the Visitor a Thank-You After the Visit

fields.description: Asks for the reason when a pass is rejected. It is shown on the pass and in the rejection email to the host.
fields.label: Approver Must Give a Reason to Reject

fields.description: Who receives VMS alerts. Leave a table empty to fall back to the built-in role list.
fields.label: Notification Recipients

fields.description: Notified when a blacklisted visitor is matched.
fields.label: Security Alert Roles

fields.description: Receive the daily hospitality schedule digest.
fields.label: Hospitality Digest Roles

fields.description: The host and whoever raised the pass are always told what was booked. With this on, the visitor is emailed the cab or hotel details too (when the pass has an email).
fields.label: Email the Visitor When a Cab or Hotel Is Booked

fields.description: At the visitor's last check-out, and hourly for no-shows and visits never checked out, open hospitality requests are closed so the Hospitality Manager's list holds only live work.
fields.label: Close Hospitality Requests When the Visit Is Over

fields.description: Visit windows overlapping these slots auto-derive the meal plan.
fields.label: Meal Windows

fields.description: When off, only visitors holding an invitation link can pre-register. Turn on to let anyone open the public form (for example from a QR code at reception).
fields.label: Allow Pre-Registration Without an Invitation

fields.description: Guest pre-registration submissions allowed per identity, per hour, before the public portal rate-limits further attempts. 0 is read as unset (falls back to the default), not as no limit.
fields.label: Max Portal Submissions per Hour

fields.description: Controls how the public pre-registration page looks. The whole palette is derived from the brand colour, so one setting themes the page.
fields.label: Portal Branding

fields.description: Used for step markers, focus rings and the submit button.
fields.label: Brand Colour

fields.description: Shown above the form title. Leave blank to show no logo.
fields.label: Portal Logo

fields.description: Shown beside the logo and in the page footer.
fields.label: Organisation Name

fields.description: Optional line under the form — e.g. a privacy statement or help contact.
fields.label: Footer Note

fields.description: What visitors are told about their personal data on the public pre-registration form, and whether they must agree before they can submit. Each pass created through the form records that the visitor agreed, when, and to which version of the notice.
fields.label: Privacy Notice & Consent

fields.description: Visitors must tick a box under the notice before they can submit the public form.
fields.label: Require Consent on the Public Form

fields.description: Recorded on each pass with the visitor's consent. It is raised by one when you change the notice text and leave this as it is; you can also set your own reference (for example 2026-10).
fields.label: Privacy Notice Version

fields.description: Shown above the consent box. Leave blank to show the standard notice, which says what is collected (name, contact details, photograph, government ID), why (identity check, visitor pass, site security, legal duties), who sees it and how to ask for correction or deletion. Write your own text to name your organisation, your retention period and a contact for privacy requests.
fields.label: Privacy Notice Text

fields.description: DPDP / GDPR-style data minimisation for visitor identity data. OFF by default — nothing is ever deleted or anonymised unless this is explicitly turned on.
fields.label: Data Retention & Purge

fields.description: When ticked, a nightly job anonymises name, mobile, email, ID number and photos on visits that are already over (Checked-Out, Rejected, Cancelled or No-Show) and older than the retention period. The visit record itself — dates, host, gate, badge, workflow history — is kept for audit and statistics. Leave this OFF until your compliance/legal function has confirmed a retention period: this app never purges anything on its own.
fields.label: Enable Data Retention Purge

fields.description: How long, after a visit is over, its identity data is kept before being anonymised. Only takes effect once Enable Data Retention Purge is ticked.
fields.label: Retention Period (days)
